Audiobooks

Narrated over 126 audiobooks available on the LitRes platform. His portfolio spans a wide range of genres — from classical literature (William Faulkner’s The Sound and the Fury, Jack London’s The Sea-Wolf) and philosophy (Erich Fromm’s To Have or to Be?, Perry Anderson’s The Origins of Postmodernity) to contemporary fiction, thrillers, and non-fiction. Featured authors include Paulo Coelho, Michael Roach, Tatiana Ustinova, Amor Towles, David Grann, Viktor Tsoi, Egor Letov, and others.
